name: Striving For Excellence
overview: Scripture calls believers to pursue excellence by faithfully stewarding the responsibilities God has given them, as seen in Genesis 1:28 where mankind is commanded to subdue and have dominion over the earth. This pursuit is grounded in obedience to God's commandments, promising elevation and blessing when His ways are followed (Deuteronomy 28:13). Committing all works to the Lord establishes our efforts (Proverbs 16:3), and true excellence is reflected in the fruit of diligent labor (Proverbs 31:31). Ultimately, believers are called to strive for spiritual perfection, modeled after the heavenly Father (Matthew 5:48), recognizing that only through dependence on Christ’s living water can this standard be approached (John 4:13).
